title: gpux fast mode: retained layout and views, splice, scroll layers and window composition from gpui-fast

checks.descriptionMarkdown: New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/switches.rs`. It covers every environment variable and alias, precedence, implication normalization, the compiled-scope rule for layers, runtime toggling equal to a from-scratch frame, release of owned state over 1,000 toggles, and zero counters while off.
New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/stats.rs`. It covers per-frame reset, run accumulation, bypass-reason indexing, and counters for one frame of each mechanism stub.
A default-feature build of `gpux`. It fails if ungated code references `FastStats` or other measurement-only items.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/oracle.rs` with `oracle_support.rs`. Mutation tests prove the frame description detects each field kind. The randomized cached-view oracle runs 16 seeds × 60 steps, with a non-vacuity assertion on cached reuse.
New group `crates/gpux_conformance/tests/lane_a_fast_parity.rs`: every lane-A catalog scene with fast mode all on and all off, with equal captures.
New group `crates/gpux_conformance/tests/lane_c_fast_parity.rs`: every lane-C scene rendered on the host's lane-C renderer with fast mode all on and all off, with byte-identical pixels.
The new `fast_mode` bench in Criterion test mode. Every `fast/<scenario>/<mode>` id runs once, with its counter assertions; no timing is involved.

New group `crates/gpui/tests/fast_mode_attribution.rs`: exact counter shapes per scenario and mode. Modes not yet implemented assert that they equal `off`. Later sprints amend the expectations as each mechanism lands; that is the same group, not a new suite.

New group `tooling/testkit/tests/fast_mode_report.rs`: parses recorded Criterion and `gpux-fast-stats` fixture output, renders the report tables, deltas and ranking, `--compare` between two fixture runs, and lane G's bench plan including `fast_mode`.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/scoped_invalidation.rs`: programmatic scroll and `ScrollActivity` steps, hover, active and group-hover changes, editable-text and selection redraws, and key-dispatch redraws. Each leaves `refreshing` false and matches the from-scratch frame.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/bounds_grid.rs`: grid orders against the existing `BoundsTree` and a brute-force reference over random sequences, replay across frames with moved bounds, all three bands, degenerate and NaN bounds, and comparison-budget fallback.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/draw_order.rs`: counting sort and packed fallback equal to a stable comparison sort, equal-key order for every family, sprite texture grouping, and the already-sorted fast path.

Group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/glyph_runs.rs`: per-run glyph parameters equal to per-glyph parameters, and lines painted by runs equal to frames drawn from scratch. Number shaping and the path cache, whose tests left with them, were reverted under SC-4.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/layout_keys.rs`: path, id and index keys, sibling insert, remove and reorder keeping other nodes clean, duplicate keys, prepaint-scope keys, release, lingering list rows, bounded growth under churn, and the off path unchanged.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/write_elision.rs`: style and children writes only on change, a fingerprint change for each converted field, exact confirmation on equal fingerprints, and an unchanged stretched root.

Group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/text_carry.rs`: carry, colour-only carry, equal-size replay, size-change re-measure, probe settling, truncation and wrapping, non-text leaves still dirtied, no retained closures, kept line layouts, a text leaf replaced by another element, and fonts installed under carried text.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/oracle_layout.rs`: the randomized oracle in layout-only mode across all change kinds, plus targeted sticky, container-query and handoff cases, with a non-vacuity assertion on clean nodes.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/dependencies.rs`: one test per read kind and per change rule, idempotent state writes, and the `ElementInputHandler` exemption. Also: ambient input reloaded outside dispatch, and an app that never records holding no stamps.
New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/dependency_nesting.rs`: own versus subtree sets, and replay re-registering accessed entities.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/retained_records.rs`: one test per copied output (DevKit remap and rollback included), sticky candidates of an outer scroll container, positioned and top-layer bands, deferred attribution, and window-owned effect requests.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/reuse_paths.rs`: still-frame reuse, built-at-retained-layout for each inherited-context change, a changed text style building the view, dependency-aware `cached(style)`, and `RenderOnce` never retained. The prebuilt path is checked with splice.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/view_invalidation.rs`: exact reader invalidation per dependency kind, the notify and update rules, innermost-view interactions, and each disabling condition with its counter.
New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/verify_mode.rs`: the shadow frame names a view that reads untracked `Rc<RefCell<_>>` state, and presented output is unaffected.
New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/oracle_views.rs`: the randomized oracle in views mode, with a non-vacuity assertion on reused subtrees.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/splice.rs`: a single nested rebuild, multiple gaps, gap layout fallback taking over prebuilt children, deferred draws, inherited gpux stacks, and dispatch depth stable over 1,000 frames.
New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/own_dirty.rs`: an own-read change marks the view dirty and its ancestors are spliced.
New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/oracle_splice.rs`: the randomized oracle in splice mode, with a non-vacuity assertion on spliced views.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/composition.rs` on a recording test platform: the API and transactions, unsupported defaults, a byte-identical disabled path, per-surface scenes (the top-layer band and the overlay range), balanced clips, `reuse_starts` under cached, retained and spliced reuse, and bounds pushed only on change.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/composition_overlay.rs`: grayscale glyph requests for overlay ranges under a subpixel-capable window, and backdrop effects on the overlay limited to GPUI content.

New lane D platform checks `composition-macos-*` (in `crates/gpux_conformance/src/platform_checks.rs` and the desktop host): view order and bounds, input routing, and the shadow pixels over a native view (skipped with the reason without screen capture). Runs on a Mac.

New lane D platform checks `composition-wayland-*`: subsurface order, positions and input regions. Runs in a Wayland session: on this macOS machine, headless sway in the local Lima VM `gpux` (a Linux desktop or WSLg per `LINUX-WSL.md` elsewhere); skipped with the reason outside one.

checks.descriptionMarkdown: New lane D platform checks `composition-windows-*`: visual tree order, portal bounds and clip, device-loss rebuild, accelerator pass-through and live resize, through OS screenshots. Run by CI's `lane D (windows-2025)` job (WARP) on the pushed HEAD; this check reads that job's results.
argv:
set -e
sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- crates tooling tools-node Cargo.toml Cargo.lock; then
  echo "uncommitted product changes: CI proves pushed commits only"; exit 1
fi
if ! git branch -r --contains "$sha" | grep -q .; then
  echo "$sha is not pushed: CI has not run on it"; exit 1
fi
run=$(gh run list --repo rayx-ui/Gpux --workflow ci.yml --commit "$sha" --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId')
[ -n "$run" ] || { echo "no CI run for $sha"; exit 1; }
job=$(gh run view "$run" --repo rayx-ui/Gpux --json jobs -q '.jobs[] | select(.name=="lane D (windows-2025)") | "\(.databaseId) \(.status)"')
case "$job" in *" completed") ;; *) echo "CI lane D (windows-2025) for $sha has not finished: $job"; exit 1;; esac
gh api --allow-escape-sequences "repos/rayx-ui/Gpux/actions/jobs/${job%% *}/logs" | sed 's/^[^ ]* //' | grep -a "composition-windows" > /tmp/gpux-composition-windows.log || true
cat /tmp/gpux-composition-windows.log
passed=$(grep -c "PASS composition-windows" /tmp/gpux-composition-windows.log || true)
failed=$(grep -c "FAIL composition-windows" /tmp/gpux-composition-windows.log || true)
echo "CI run $run, commit $sha"
echo "gpux-testkit: $passed passed, $failed failed, 0 skipped"
[ "$failed" = 0 ]

checks.descriptionMarkdown: New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/layer_policy.rs`: promotion, the three decisions, change-rate and work-budget demotion, cooldown doubling and reset, idle eviction, resize drop, the compiled scope, and the switch gating snapping.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/layer_carry.rs`: scroll-only detection (scroll dependents included), carried and translated outputs, repaint before non-wheel input, and translated `ScrollHandle` bounds.
New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/layer_inputs.rs`: tile hashing, including the transform matrix, background baking, glyph reach culling, path lifting, and one test per bypass reason.
New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/oracle_layers.rs`: the randomized layers oracle at scales 1 and 1.25, with expanded scenes, hit tests and listener positions, and coverage assertions.

New renderer group `crates/gpui_wgpu/src/fast/layers/tests.rs`, on the adapter `GPUX_WGPU_ADAPTER` selects (the Mac's GPU through wgpu locally; the software adapter in the Linux VM). Byte-equality of a layer drawn from tiles, negative coordinates, odd translations, a second frame from cache, paths drawn over tiles (a tile holds none), the premultiplied flag, the generation contract, LRU eviction, release on resize, after a failed frame and after a GPU error, and Rust size and offset assertions for the flag.

New group `crates/gpux_conformance/tests/lane_c_scroll_layers.rs`: views scrolled from tiles (text rows at scales 1, 1.5 and 2, cards with shadows and gradients, shadowed cards closer together than their blurs reach, paths, both axes, content that changes while scrolled, small scrolls from the top of content with a margin) against the layers-off, snapping-on reference on the lane-C renderer, frame for frame: pixel-identical, but within a shadow blur's reach of the viewport's top and bottom edges, where the layered frame may only be darker and never on a card. Metal on a Mac, the software wgpu adapter on Linux and Windows. A `uniform_list` and a `list` of text rows scroll from tiles too, at scales 1 and 1.5 and with rows that change while scrolled, pixel-identical everywhere.

Lane B's Dawn-validation and backend specs on WebGPU and forced WebGL2, for the polychrome record flag and the WGSL dither change. Before the sprint starts, resolve the exact `--grep` pattern to the specs that cover forced WebGL2.
New renderer group `crates/gpui_apple/src/fast/layers/tests.rs` on a headless Metal device: the same tile byte-equality cases as wgpu, plus the dither seed. Runs on a Mac.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/list_layers.rs`: row records, extend versus repaint, overscan growth and dropping, row reads, hovers, `is_scrolled_to_end` and `scroll_to_end`, a changed item count, lingering nodes, and the list oracle; gpux's own group: two lists in one view, a change every row reads, a state changed without a notification, lists a layer cannot carry (sticky rows, a flipped uniform list), rows reaching outside their room, and what a frame shown from a layer tells (DevKit elements, debug bounds, tab order, listeners, whole frame descriptions over random histories). After the first review: padded lists, a `list` told of its rows' focus, a sheet from another view over the rows, a press and a release where the pointer was not moved to, fractional wheel turns, rows that handle text input, and a scroll back up and a jump over rows that can be hit outside their room; frame descriptions carry what a pointer hits down two columns of the rows.
New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/defaults.rs`: gpui-fast defaults on a new window, each `GPUX_*=0`, `GPUX_FAST_MODE=0`, and the aliases.

New lane F scenes `composition-ios-*`: view order and frames, tap pass-through and overlay capture, and shadow pixels over a native view (skipped with the reason without a Metal device). Runs on a Mac with Xcode.

New group `tooling/testkit/tests/android_java.rs`: the Gradle-free build plan compiles `crates/gpui_mobile/java/**` with `javac` and `d8` against the pinned `android.jar`, places `classes.dex` in the APK, and reports a missing JDK or build-tools with the installing command.

New lane E scenes `composition-android-*`: order, tap pass-through and overlay capture, a pan on overlay content over the native view, and menu shadow pixels over a native `View`, read through `adb screencap` with the 16-bit tolerance. Runs with an emulator or device attached. The shadow scene skips on GL, where the overlay is cut out of native views (CMP-11).

New lane E scenes `platform-view-*`: a generic platform view between GPUI content and an open menu, clipped by its parent, its panel window untouched by a second view and gone once disposed; and a web view whose panel takes and returns the window focus.
New lane F scenes `platform-view-*`: the same on the iOS Simulator.

New group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/layer_touch.rs`: a touch pan, fling momentum, a tap after a fling and a long press over a layered container. Each composites or repaints as specified and matches the layers-off reference.

New Playwright spec `tools-node/specs/scroll-layers.spec.ts` (its non-`@timing` tests): composited frames through `__gpuxFastStats`, and screenshot equality with a layers-off load, on WebGPU and forced WebGL2.
New lane E scenes `scroll-layers-*`: swiped div and list, composited counters, `adb screencap` equality with layers off, and tiles rebuilt after background and resume.
New lane F scenes `scroll-layers-*`: panned div and list, composited counters, pixel equality with layers off where a Metal device exists, and tiles rebuilt after background and resume.
Formatting of the whole workspace (a cheap, whole-tree tool).
Clippy on every package the epic touches.
The WASM build of `gpux-web`, which composition and the shared renderer changes touch.
`cargo package --workspace`. The epic adds a bench target, features and platform dependencies (DirectComposition `windows` features, Wayland subcompositor, webview example dev-dependencies).
All of lane A. **Whole-codebase reason:** the final sprint turns fast mode on by default, which changes how every element in every window is laid out and drawn (core rendering and runtime).
All of lane C. **Whole-codebase reason:** the same as `final-lane-a`, plus the renderer ABI and tile changes.

All of lane D on the implementer's desktop OS. **Whole-codebase reason:** defaults-on fast mode and composition change presenting in real windows. Lane D on the other two desktop OSes comes from CI on the pull request.

Lane B's per-PR selection (`@canary` and `@pr`) plus the composition spec. **Whole-codebase reason:** defaults-on fast mode changes every browser frame. Resolve the grep syntax to the testkit's tag selection before final validation.
Android type check of `gpux-mobile` for arm64, needing `ANDROID_NDK_HOME` pointed at the pinned NDK.
iOS type check of `gpux-mobile`.
All of lane E. **Whole-codebase reason:** defaults-on fast mode changes every Android frame, and composition and tiles change the Android window.
All of lane F on the iOS Simulator. **Whole-codebase reason:** the same as `final-lane-e`, for iOS.

Group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/hover_dependencies.rs`: a wheel event moving the pointer off a hovered cached view, an overlay covering one with the pointer still without notifying its observers, the oracle's seed 31, an overlay covering the group a cached cell's `group_hover` reads, the pointer entering a group redrawn under new hitbox ids, and a view reading only its own hovers still replayed.
The hover-read-scope test in `fast/tests/hover_dependencies.rs`: a view without hover styles, one with a hover style elsewhere, and one under its styled box.
`gpux-mobile` type-checks for Android with its default feature set, the embedded host: composition must not depend on items the `android-native-activity` feature gates.

New core group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/layer_renderers.rs`: tile sprites carry the premultiplied flag, and a frame drawn from scratch or an entry removed from the sprite atlas leaves no layer content, the next content taking a new generation with every tile dirty.

New core group `crates/gpui/src/fast/tests/layer_extent.rs`: a layer over content with top padding, a first-child margin or padding all round composites within a quarter viewport of its top and reaches its end, each frame drawing what a window without layers draws.

tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `gpui_linux/src/fast/composition/wayland.rs` and the client and window hooks. Add the `composition-wayland-*` checks.

tasks.title: X11 child-window composition with cut-outs and overlay window
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `gpui_linux/src/fast/composition/x11.rs` and the hooks, including `Background::is_opaque`. Add the `composition-x11-*` checks.

sprints.title: Window composition on Windows (DirectComposition over wgpu) and the browser

tasks.title: Windows DirectComposition backend
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Spike option (a) against option (b) under fast height-only live resize, and record the evidence in `docs/upstream/gpui-fast.md`. Then implement the gpux-owned DirectComposition tree, CompositionVisual overlay renderers, portals, device-loss recreation and the accelerator rule. Add the `composition-windows-*` checks.

tasks.title: Browser overlay canvas above the DOM overlay
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `gpui_web/src/fast/composition.rs` (overlay canvas, shared-device surface, pointer gating) and re-layer the `html_element` z-order. On WebGL2 it reports unsupported. Write `tools-node/specs/composition.spec.ts` and the web-host scene.

tasks.title: Native webview examples
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the manual examples (WKWebView, WebView2, WebKitGTK and a Wayland surface) with crates.io dev-dependencies, and run each on its platform.

sprints.title: Window composition on iOS and Android, and gpui-mobile platform views on top of it

tasks.title: iOS composition backend
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `gpui_mobile/src/ios/fast/composition.rs`: native `UIView` containers, a `GPUIOverlayView` (transparent `CAMetalLayer` with a sharing renderer on `Backends::METAL`), `hitTest:` gating, touch forwarding, rotation and safe-area geometry, background and resume, and release ordering. Add the `composition-ios-*` lane F scenes with a solid-colour native test view.

tasks.title: Android composition backend and Java helper
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Spike panel windows against a managed hierarchy with a top-ordered translucent overlay `SurfaceView` in both host modes, and record the evidence. Add the `dev.gpux.mobile` Java helper under `crates/gpui_mobile/java/`, the `javac`/`d8` step in `gpux-testkit android build`, and `gpui_mobile/src/android/fast/composition.rs` (JNI wiring, overlay sharing renderer per backend, touch forwarding, lifecycle). Add `tooling/testkit/tests/android_java.rs` and the `composition-android-*` lane E scenes.

tasks.title: Rebuild gpui-mobile platform views on composition
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Move the iOS and Android `PlatformView` implementations into composition native surfaces, and place `platform_view_element` through `native_surface`. Replace `RayXPlatformView` with the gpux helper, and remove the below-Metal-view insertion. Add the `platform-view-*` scenes to lanes E and F.

tasks.title: Layer policy, compiled scope and switch
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `fast/layers/{mod,policy,work}.rs`. Gate snapping and quantization on the switch. Write `fast/tests/layer_policy.rs`.

tasks.title: Scroll-only detection, carrying and input
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `fast/layers/{invalidate,reuse,input,record}.rs`, counting gpux scroll dependents. Write `fast/tests/layer_carry.rs`.

tasks.title: Touch pans and fling momentum as scrolls
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Note scrolled containers from the `TouchGestureRecognizer` pan and fling scroll path, and classify touch input for layers (pan moves as scroll input, other touches repainting moved content). Write `fast/tests/layer_touch.rs`.

tasks.title: Layer painting, tiles, background and bypass reasons
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `fast/layers/{paint,tiles,scene,background}.rs` and glyph quantization and reach. Shift transforms into content space, and add the gpux bypass reasons. Write `fast/tests/layer_inputs.rs`.

tasks.title: Layers oracle
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `fast/layers/verify.rs` expansion into `fast::verify`, and the layers oracle. Write `fast/tests/oracle_layers.rs`. Update the attribution expectations for `layers` (div scenarios). Keep both fast-mode parity groups green with layers on: lane A through the expanded frame description, lane C through the renderer capability.

sprints.title: Scroll-layer tiles in the wgpu and Metal renderers

tasks.title: wgpu tile cache, raster and composite
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `fast/layers/{tile_cache,raster,composite}.rs` and the hooks that draw tiles with the renderer's own batch functions, the premultiplied polychrome flag in Rust and WGSL, the dither seed and the exact fragment positions. In the core: drop layer content on a frame drawn from scratch and when an atlas entry is removed, and make a layer's content everything its container scrolls over. Write the renderer tests, the core groups and `lane_c_scroll_layers.rs` (registered in lane C), and run lane B for the ABI.

tasks.title: Metal tile cache, raster and composite
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `gpui_apple/src/fast/layers/` into the frame's command buffer, with the Metal shader changes (premultiplied flag, dither seed, exact fragment positions). Write the Metal tests.

sprints.title: Scroll layers for uniform_list and list

tasks.title: Per-row list layers
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Port `fast/layers/lists.rs` adapted to gpux lists, with lingering row nodes. Write `fast/tests/list_layers.rs` with the list oracle. Update the attribution expectations for the list and chat scenarios. Make the rows a layer holds off screen inert in what the frame answers by, keep the rows shown in row order for the tab key and the DevKit snapshot, and describe such a frame by the rows shown (`fast/verify.rs`). Add list rows to `lane_c_scroll_layers`. After the first review: keep a row that read hovers only where no hitbox of the frame can change them, show the rows the list's own layout renders, hold no row lying across the bounds unshown, draw the row a `list` draws off screen after the layer, draw only shown rows on the fallback, let no row off screen handle text input, and leave a record out of the description only while it answers nothing.

sprints.title: Scroll layers in the browser, on Android and on iOS

tasks.title: Browser scroll layers on WebGPU and WebGL2
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Enable layers on wasm32 with the browser budget, publish `__gpuxFastStats` under `diagnostics`, and add the web-host layers-off URL switch. Write `tools-node/specs/scroll-layers.spec.ts`, including the `@timing` test that only lane G runs.

tasks.title: Android scroll layers
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Enable layers on Android with the mobile budget. Add the `PlatformWindow` memory-pressure hook and call it from `onTrimMemory`, background and surface loss in both host modes. Add counter reporting to the Android host and the `scroll-layers-*` lane E scenes.

tasks.title: iOS scroll layers
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Enable layers on iOS with the mobile budget. Call the memory-pressure hook from `didReceiveMemoryWarning` and background. Add counter reporting to the iOS host and the `scroll-layers-*` lane F scenes.

sprints.title: Defaults on, documentation, and the final comparison

tasks.title: Turn gpui-fast's defaults on
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Flip the compiled defaults in `fast/mode.rs`. Write `fast/tests/defaults.rs`. Update the attribution and parity groups for the new defaults.

tasks.title: Fast-mode documentation
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `docs/fast-mode.md`, and update `docs/testing.md`, the README, `docs/upstream/gpui-fast.md`'s module table and the gpux skill reference.

tasks.title: Lane G comparison and the benefit summary
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Run `gpux-testkit lane g` on macOS and on a wgpu desktop, including the browser `@timing` layers comparison. Run the Android and iOS hosts' layers-on and layers-off scroll scenes on devices. Compare against the s01 baseline and write the per-mechanism summary in `docs/fast-mode.md`.
